gloss_en: the three mochin (the three brains/mentalities — the kabbalistic triad of intellects, Chokhmah-Binah-Da'at, in the head), from which prayer and the three kinds of compassion are drawn, each serving as a spread-out partition (mechitzah perusah) guarding against sexual lust; vocalized מִשָּׁלֹשׁ הַמֹּחִין, 'from the three mochin'
